name: nucleo-f446ze
comment: A Nucleo-144 board carrying an STM32F446ZE: Cortex-M4F with a single-precision FPU, 512 KB of flash, 128 KB of SRAM and 64 KB of core-coupled memory. Programmed through the ST-LINK already on the board.

flash.comment: 512 KB, the whole of the on-chip flash

ram.comment: 128 KB of SRAM, where the stack and the data live

ccm.comment: 64 KB of core-coupled memory, reachable by the core only and not by DMA

flash.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f4x.cfg -c "program {binary} verify reset exit"
flash.comment: Flashing reaches the part through the ST-LINK, which every Nucleo-144 board carries

debug.comment: The vendor's register map for this part, from the CMSIS device data repository. A project that carries its own keeps it: what a project has committed to it is a fact about the project, and this is only consulted when nothing does.
